note: run 1 is used (retrieval determinism across runs is checked per arm in metrics.json); 'relevant' = the added document is a gold document of the question (the v3 rule); 'hub-only' = every bridge concept the added document shares with a seed has document frequency > hub_threshold (the V1 hub cut would drop it); 'displaced' = a gold document in B2's top 10 (same run) that is not in this arm's top 10 while this arm did search documents.
